name: agishub
description: Pay-per-call tools for AI agents over x402 micropayments on Base (USDC).

services.title: timezone-toolkit
services.description: World clock, timezone conversion, date math & meeting scheduling for AI agents.

tools.name: now_in
tools.description: Current local time in an IANA timezone (offset, abbreviation, DST).

tools.name: convert_timezone
tools.description: Convert a datetime between two IANA zones (ISO or natural language).

tools.name: convert_batch
tools.description: Convert one instant into many timezones at once (world clock).

tools.name: tz_offset
tools.description: Exact UTC offset of a zone at a given instant (DST-aware).

tools.name: lookup_timezone
tools.description: Resolve a city or country to its IANA timezone(s).

tools.name: date_math
tools.description: Add/subtract time respecting DST, or diff two datetimes across zones.

tools.name: find_meeting_slots
tools.description: Overlapping working-hour slots across timezones (excludes weekends & holidays). Free tier: 1 slot.

tools.name: is_holiday
tools.description: Check if a date is a public holiday in a country (Nager.Date).

tools.name: list_timezones
tools.description: List or search valid IANA timezone names.

services.title: Agis Web Scraper
services.description: Read any public web page as clean markdown. Optional JS rendering for SPAs.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Fetch any public URL and return its main content as clean markdown. Optional render:true for JS-heavy pages / SPAs.
